negativeOrNullFindings: The respiratory failure signal is the central safety story (PMIDs 39073583, 39133282) and PMID 40704461 adds bradycardia and arrhythmia. A terlipressin page citing only CONFIRM's efficacy would be misleading.
PMID 34606933 is an explicitly critical appraisal of CONFIRM - include it rather than only the trial.
cautions: Hepatorenal syndrome nomenclature changed from 'type 1 HRS' to 'HRS-AKI' mid-way through this literature. Trials are not directly comparable across the definitional change.

Hard content ban applies with force here: no infusion rates, no dose comparisons framed as guidance. PMID 26659927 and PMID 36542261 compare administration routes - describe that such comparisons exist without reproducing regimens.
